subject.title: feat(gateway): add system.info RPC and Gateway Host card in Settings

question: Should `system.info` expose gateway host identity/resource fields under `operator.read` and render them in Quick Settings once the compatibility bug and UI proof gap are fixed?
rationale: This adds a new core gateway protocol and Settings surface with some host metadata overlap with `system-presence`, so maintainer intent is needed even though the implementation shape is mostly bounded.

options.title: Accept after fixes
options.body: Keep the new RPC/card direction, but require advertised-method gating, old-gateway fallback handling, and real UI proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into existing diagnostics
options.body: Use or extend `system-presence`/Instances as the canonical host diagnostics surface instead of adding a separate Settings card.

options.title: Defer core surface
options.body: Leave the linked feature issue open until maintainers decide this host-metrics card belongs in core Control UI.

recommendation.title: Accept after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the new RPC/card direction, but require advertised-method gating, old-gateway fallback handling, and real UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the linked product request and has the freshest related Settings/protocol history.
